stem: Albumin is a protein that is secreted by liver cells and transported to the bloodstream. What factor most directly determines the amino acids that are combined to create albumin?

options.label: A
options.text: The temperature of the cell when translation is taking place

options.label: B
options.text: The number of chromosomes in a cell

options.label: C
options.text: The sequence of nucleotides in DNA

options.label: D
options.text: The amount of energy that is available in the cell
